title: Taurus — The Cosmos Has Your Warning
youtube_description: Discover why Mercury is squaring your ruling Venus today and how it could sway love and finances. Taurus, this reading reveals the quiet gift arriving from Saturn’s steady flow—if you stay grounded. Comment your sign for a personalized peek!
script_text: Stop! Taurus, the heavens slam a harsh square between Mercury and your ruling Venus, shaking your routine. Mercury squaring Venus in the 10th House urges you to pause before broadcasting any important announcements. Venus trines Saturn in your 2nd House, bringing steady financial support if you act with patience and careful planning. If you're single, a calm Virgo draws you in; couples should watch Venus‑Saturn tension flare into lingering silence, and deepen connections. Your 10th House career feels the square today, so avoid rash decisions and stick to proven methods for your growth. The 2nd House money gains from Venus's trine to Saturn, offering a chance to secure small bonuses or a side‑gig. Avoid impulsive spending or heated arguments; honor Saturn's steady flow for a surprise gift. Follow for tomorrow's reading so you never miss the next daily cosmic update.
